scripts.build: npm run build --workspace core && npm run build --workspace client && npm run build --workspace server
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start --workspace server
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace core && npm run test --workspace server && npm run test --workspace client
scripts.android:sync: npm run build --workspace core && npm run build --workspace client && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:run: npm run android:sync && npx cap run android
